openingNote.lead: Thank you for thinking of Kieran on his birthday.
paragraphs: We’re so grateful for the people in Kieran’s life who love and care about him.

We’re working with Kieran to turn the garage into a playroom for him and Samayah to enjoy together. If you’d like to give him a gift, he’d love something he can use there. We made this page to show you the type of playroom we're hoping to build!

There’s no pressure to give a gift at all, and certainly not something new from this list. The items on the list are just ideas/examples and are often very expensive — we probably won't buy those exact items but instead find similar products secondhand.
The pictures below are inspiration. We expect to find many of these things used on Craigslist or Facebook Marketplace. There’s no need to match an exact item or spend a lot.

Secondhand finds are very welcome—and so is anything else you think would be a good fit for his playroom. We especially like natural wood, cotton and wool, sturdy construction, and high quality materials.

closingNote.title: Thank you for being part of his world.
paragraphs: We’re grateful for your thoughtfulness and for the love you bring to Kieran’s life.
If you’d like to give a gift, a secondhand find or another idea for the playroom is just as welcome as anything shown here. There’s no need to match the list—and no pressure to give a gift.
